_note: Per-scene speaker label overrides. Used when the same surface label maps to different cast members in different scenes — most commonly the duet pronouns ער/זיא. Consulted by auto_resolve_flags before cast_dict lookup. Decided in conversation with Noa 2026-06-14.
_schema: Each scene has `pages` (list of page numbers) and optional `lines` (list of 0-indexed line indices within those pages, scoping the override to specific lines on the page — for cases where a single page hosts multiple disguised duets). Without `lines`, the override applies to all matching labels on the listed pages.

scenes.context: p.61 doves scene — Zelikel + Tsierele dressed as doves. Includes the טויבען collective label (line 3) and the ער/זיא alternations (lines 4-6).
